dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast perimeters. A prominent 'O' structure in the upper-left quadrant shows a rapid gradient transition from dark-brown exterior pixels to a light-tan interior. Central 'C' shapes feature thinner, irregular light-intensity boundaries with diffuse edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate to high spatial density of localized, solid light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. Concentration is highest in the lower-left and mid-dorsal regions, filling the interstices between larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent structures (upper-left annulus, mid-right irregular loop, and lower-left blob cluster) define an obtuse scalene triangle. The longest geometric vector connects the mid-right and lower-left centroids.
